title: Wringer bench manifest
description: `manifest.json` of a bench bundle — `.wringer/benches/<bench_id>/`. The comparison, and NOTHING that ranks it: there is no winner, no score, and no ordering field anywhere in this format, because the one fact that would justify a ranking — was the fix honest — is precisely the fact this machinery cannot establish (SPEC_BENCH_V0 ruling 6). `contenders` is in DECLARED order and a reader may rely on that, with the diffs in front of them.

schema_version.description: Identifies the bundle format a reader is holding.

bench_id.description: Also names the worktrees — `<bench_id>-<contender_id>`, never the bare contender id, because a colliding worktree path is force-removed and contender ids are stable across benches.

started_at.description: Local ISO-8601 with offset, seconds precision.

baseline.description: The job. A bench of repair needs something to repair, so a green baseline is refused before any of this is written.

sha.description: The detached sha every contender worktree was checked against. One tree, checked rather than assumed.

run_dir.description: The baseline's verify bundle, by path, inside the kept baseline worktree.

failing_gates.description: The required gates that failed at the baseline: the work every row was measured on.

contender_wall_clock.description: The SAME ceiling every contender's loop was handed. Enforcement is the loop's own, which stops after finishing the step in flight, so a contender's true ceiling is this plus at most one worker turn plus one verify — the loop's documented behaviour, not bench's to re-legislate.

contenders.description: One row per contender, in DECLARED order — never outcome order. A test pins that a later contender which converged faster does not float up.

outcome.description: A loop reason, or `error`. Not a grade.

usage.description: PRESENT ONLY when the agent reported it. Absent means unreported, never zero.

limits.description: What this artifact does NOT say, travelling with the numbers rather than living in a spec nobody opened — a benchmark is the artifact most likely to be read as a larger claim than it is. At minimum three entries, and a test pins each by CONTENT: one run per contender; usage is the agent's own unverified report; and a green gate proves the gates went green, not that the fix is honest.
